# list-indent

- ID: `MD005`
- Category: Lists
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `bullet`, `ul`, `indentation`

Items in a list start at the same column. Ordered numbers may right-align.

## Why

Misaligned items can make later lines attach to the wrong item.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix moves the items of an ordered list into line. gomdlint reports bullet
items without a fix, and some others, such as items that hold a second
paragraph, a code block or a quote. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix
when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\]
or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or
remove a task list checkbox. In a document with raw HTML other than comments and
plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint reports every finding without a fix.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `list-indent: false` turns the rule off and `list-indent: error`
reports its findings as errors. The flag `--disable list-indent` turns it off
for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line list-indent -->
```
